senses.gloss: ch. same; (cmp. טפי, a. נוֹטֵף s. v. נָטַף) tusks, canine teeth; also pl. נִיבֵי.
units: Targ. Ps. LVIII, 7 (h. text מלתעות).—[Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIV, 7 נ׳ לסתיה his molar teeth; (h. text לֵחֹה!).]—
<cite ref="Chullin 59a:9">Ḥull. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>גמלא נ׳ אית ליה</he> a camel has canine teeth.
<cite ref="Shabbat 63b:2">Sabb. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>שקילי נִיבֵיה</he> his (the dog’s) tusks are gone.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86:3">Gen. R. s. 86</cite>, <he>פכרון ניביה</he> break its tusks out; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 145:14">Yalk. ib. 145</cite> <he>תברון ניביה</he>.
Ib. מסתכל בניביה, v. סְכַל I.—Trnsf. the sinews connecting the hip-bone with its socket.
<cite ref="Chullin 54b:3">Ḥull. 54ᵇ</cite> <he>איפסוק ניביה</he> (some ed. <cite ref="Q01351"><he>איפסיק</he></cite>) its sinews are severed.
